description: List streams the signed-in account owns, including unpublished DRAFT streams, with optional filters and pagination. Use it to find IDs for create_stream_post, update_stream, publish_stream or delete_stream. Use streams_following for streams you follow, and search or streams_all for the public catalog.

limit.description: Maximum number of streams in this page.

nextToken.description: nextToken from the previous page; keep the other filters and sortBy unchanged.

pricingType.description: FREE: no direct price and not package-only. PAID: sold as a direct subscription. PACKAGE_ONLY: sold only in stream packages. ALL or omitted: any pricing.

sortBy.description: FOLLOWERS sorts most-followed first, CREATED_AT newest first. When omitted, ACTIVE streams first (states sort alphabetically), then featured, then most-followed.

streamCategory.description: Only streams in this topic category. Omit for any category.

streamState.description: Only streams in this lifecycle state; DRAFT streams are not yet published. Omit for any state.

streamType.description: Only PUBLIC or only PRIVATE streams. PRIVATE streams are visible only to their owner and to users who follow, subscribe to, were invited to, or have organization access to them.

name: streams_created
title: List my streams
